description: This file implements the ShippingService interface, providing methods for managing shipping configurations, calculating shipping quotes, and retrieving supported countries in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ShippingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ShippingService interface, managing shipping configurations, quotes, and country support in an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping configuration for a given merchant store by deserializing stored JSON.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a specific shipping module's integration configuration based on module code.

methods.name: getCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom configuration for a specific shipping module.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves a shipping configuration by serializing it into JSON and storing it.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Returns the list of available shipping modules applicable to the store's region.

methods.name: saveShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates, encrypts, and saves a shipping quote module configuration.

methods.name: removeShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a shipping quote module configuration.

methods.name: removeCustomShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a custom shipping quote module configuration.

methods.name: getShippingModulesConfigured
methods.description: Fetches all shipping module configurations for a store.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary of the shipping quote including cost, handling, and module info.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Calculates shipping options and quotes based on store, delivery, products, and language.

methods.name: getSupportedCountries
methods.description: Returns a list of country codes supported for shipping from merchant configuration.

methods.name: getShipToCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries to which shipping is available, based on configuration and store settings.

methods.name: setSupportedCountries
methods.description: Stores a list of supported country codes in merchant configuration.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines whether the cart items require physical shipping based on product attributes.
